segments.scene_heading: 5-1 Night | Int. Sebastian's apartment, living room
segments.time: Night, warm lamplight indoors, city lights glowing through the window
segments.first_state: Axis and camera side for the whole scene: the camera stays on the kitchenette side of the room, by the right wall, looking across toward the front door on the left wall. The back wall, with the floor-to-ceiling window and the white bedroom door, runs along one side, and the charcoal couch is seen in profile. Natalie stands in the open bedroom doorway on the back wall in her ivory bridal gown and veil, with her pale-blue bag over her shoulder, facing into the bedroom. Sebastian, in his tuxedo, stands on the window side of the round coffee table, facing the couch. There is one charcoal three-seat couch facing the window, with the arc floor lamp at its front-door end. One round oak coffee table stands in front of the couch, between the couch and the window, with one blank white sheet of paper and one blue pen on it. One round dining table with two chairs stands between the couch and the kitchenette, near the bedroom door, and a white pillow lies on the dining chair nearer the couch.

shots.camera: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the kitchenette side; bedroom door at frame right, couch in profile at frame center
shots.visual: Natalie stops in the bedroom doorway in her wedding gown and looks into the single bedroom. Sebastian stands on the window side of the coffee table, watching her.
shots.audio: <Soft footsteps stop on the oak floor>

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single on Natalie, eye-level, framed tight on her face and shoulders
shots.visual: Natalie turns her head from the bedroom toward Sebastian, her brows raised.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, wary): {One bedroom?}

shots.camera: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Natalie's shoulder at the bedroom doorway, eye-level
shots.visual: Sebastian stands by the coffee table and tips his head toward the couch with a relaxed look.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, easy and unhurried): {Yours. I'll take the couch.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off, eye-level, on Natalie in the doorway
shots.visual: Natalie folds her arms across her bodice and lifts her chin.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, firm): {A wedding isn't permission.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, slight low angle, slow push in on Sebastian at the coffee table
shots.visual: Sebastian picks up the blank sheet of paper and the blue pen from the coffee table and holds them out toward Natalie.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, amused): {Then set the rules.}

shots.camera: Wide shot, pan following Natalie from the bedroom doorway to the couch, eye-level
shots.visual: Natalie walks from the doorway to the couch, sets her bag on the floor at the kitchenette end, sits there, takes the paper and pen from Sebastian and leans over the coffee table. Sebastian stays on the window side of the table.
shots.audio: <Satin gown rustles>

shots.camera: Close-up insert, high angle, on the sheet on the coffee table
shots.visual: Natalie's hand writes neat blue cursive on the sheet of paper.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, businesslike): {Married outside. Separate lives in here.} <Pen scratches on paper>

shots.camera: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Natalie seated on the couch, low angle up at Sebastian
shots.visual: Sebastian slides his hands into his pockets and looks down at the paper.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, calm, testing): {No other dates while we're married.}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, eye-level, on Natalie bent over the coffee table
shots.visual: Natalie keeps writing, then glances up at Sebastian with a firm look.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, crisp, counting off): {My room. My phone. My business. Knock first.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off, eye-level, on Sebastian by the coffee table
shots.visual: Sebastian gives a small nod and a half smile.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, lazy, teasing): {Done. Lock it if you want.}

shots.camera: Close-up, clean single on Natalie's face, eye-level
shots.visual: Natalie's pen stops on the paper, and she looks up at him searchingly.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, quiet): {When does this end?}

shots.camera: Medium shot, low angle, slow push in on Sebastian
shots.visual: Sebastian leans one hand on the edge of the coffee table, steady and unbothered.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, matter-of-fact): {My trust fund clears. We divorce. You walk away free.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, high angle over the coffee table, Sebastian's hand at the frame edge
shots.visual: Natalie writes one more line on the agreement and taps the pen on it.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, firm): {You pay the lawyers. I'm not paying to escape.}

segments.light_audio: Warm brass arc floor lamp at the couch's front-door end and the glass globe pendant over the dining table; city lights glow through the sheer curtains. Quiet room tone, faint distant traffic.

shots.camera: Close-up insert, high angle, on the coffee table

shots.camera: Medium close-up, eye-level, on Natalie leaning over the table
shots.visual: Natalie, cheeks flushing, quickly scoops the lace bra back into her bag.

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off, eye-level, on Sebastian across the coffee table
shots.visual: Sebastian raises one eyebrow with a slow, amused smile.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, teasing murmur): {New clause?}

shots.camera: Medium shot, pan following Sebastian from the coffee table to the dining chair and back, eye-level

shots.visual: Natalie rises with her bag and walks into the bedroom, leaving the door half closed behind her. Sebastian now stands at the kitchenette end of the couch, watching the door. The signed agreement and the pen stay on the coffee table.
shots.audio: <Bare footsteps fade, the door swings>

segments.scene_heading: 5-1 Night | Int. Sebastian's apartment, living room
segments.time: Night, warm lamplight indoors, city lights glowing through the window
segments.first_state: Natalie is inside the bedroom with her bag, behind the half-closed bedroom door on the back wall. Sebastian, in his tuxedo, stands at the kitchenette end of the couch. shots.camera: Medium shot, eye-level, on Sebastian beside the couch, the half-closed bedroom door behind him
shots.visual: Sebastian pulls off his bow tie and tuxedo jacket and drops them over the couch arm.
shots.audio: <Fabric rustles>

shots.camera: Wide shot, high angle, from the kitchenette side over the dining table
shots.visual: Across the cut, Sebastian now wears a fitted white ribbed undershirt and black lounge trousers; he settles onto the couch at its kitchenette end and sets his black phone face down on the coffee table beside the agreement.
shots.audio: <Couch cushions creak>

shots.camera: Medium shot, eye-level, on the bedroom door
shots.visual: The bedroom door opens and Natalie steps into the doorway, barefoot, in the powder-blue camisole and sleep shorts with the ivory robe hanging open.
shots.audio: <Door handle clicks>

shots.camera: Medium close-up, low angle, on Sebastian on the couch
shots.visual: Sebastian looks up from the couch toward the doorway, one arm along the couch back.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, lazy, curious): {Forget something?}

shots.camera: Medium shot, eye-level, on Natalie in the doorway, hand on the door frame
shots.visual: Natalie holds the door frame, her eyes fixed on him, nervous and determined.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, soft, hesitant): {That kiss at the wedding. Was it just for them?}

shots.camera: Wide shot, eye-level, both in profile, following Sebastian from the couch to the bedroom door
shots.visual: Sebastian rises and walks to the bedroom door, stopping one step in front of Natalie.
shots.audio: <Bare footsteps on oak>

shots.camera: Medium close-up, over-the-shoulder shot past Natalie, slight high angle on Sebastian
shots.visual: Sebastian looks down at her, a quiet smile tugging at his mouth.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, low murmur): {What do you think?}

shots.camera: Close-up insert, eye-level, on their hands between them
shots.visual: Natalie reaches out and takes Sebastian's hand.

shots.camera: Medium close-up, over-the-shoulder shot past Sebastian, slight low angle on Natalie
shots.visual: Natalie holds his hand and lifts her eyes to his.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, breathless): {I want to find out.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, eye-level, both in profile in the bedroom doorway
shots.visual: Natalie rises onto her toes and kisses Sebastian.

shots.camera: Close-up, slow orbit around the couple's faces, staying on the kitchenette side
shots.visual: Sebastian kisses her back, his free hand settling at her waist over the robe.

shots.camera: Medium shot, eye-level, on Natalie, Sebastian's shoulder at the frame edge
shots.visual: Natalie steps back into the doorway and lets go of his hand, catching her breath.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, soft, composed): {That's enough for tonight.}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, eye-level, dirty single on Sebastian with Natalie's shoulder at the frame edge
shots.visual: Sebastian lifts both hands slightly and gives a small nod.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, amused): {Your call.}
